description: Emit the ten sub-trait scores and a short rationale for one champion x role.

macro_cheat.description: Would a perfect coach, with no mechanical or read improvement, make this champion dramatically stronger than the same coaching would make an average champion?
macro_cheat.title: Macro Cheat

macro_routing.description: How many decisions about where to be does this champion's player make, and how much do they change the game? Locked to a lane and moving when the team moves is low; choosing objectives, abandoning lanes, or constraining the enemy by presence is high.
macro_routing.title: Macro Routing

macro_win_condition.description: Does good play mean building toward a specific late-game plan rather than winning exchanges in isolation?
macro_win_condition.title: Macro Win Condition

meso_cheat.description: Would knowing the enemy's hidden state before it happens make this champion dramatically stronger than it would make an average champion?
meso_cheat.title: Meso Cheat

meso_deception.description: Does the kit let the champion disguise intent or threaten falsely?
meso_deception.title: Meso Deception

meso_exploitation.description: Does power come from reading this specific opponent's habits over a match, rather than one fixed optimal line?
meso_exploitation.title: Meso Exploitation

meso_prediction.description: Does the kit force commitment before the enemy has shown what they will do? Instant and point-and-click abilities are low; slow projectiles, long casts, zones and traps aimed where the enemy will be are high.
meso_prediction.title: Meso Prediction

micro_cheat.description: Would perfect inputs alone make this champion dramatically stronger?
micro_cheat.title: Micro Cheat

micro_execution.description: Does effective use require chaining abilities in a tight timing window (cancels, resets, combo order)?
micro_execution.title: Micro Execution

micro_precision.description: Do core abilities require landing skillshots or precise placement, vs. auto-target or self-cast?
micro_precision.title: Micro Precision

rationale.description: 2-4 sentences: why these scores, tied to specific abilities.
rationale.title: Rationale

name: emit_champion_label
